threads.body: The comment above `Role` links to semconv `main` and only references the output-messages schema, but `Role` is used for both input and output messages and the repo pins semconv by `SEMCONV_GENAI_REF`. Consider referencing the schema paths (input + output) and the pin instead of a `main` URL to avoid drift/link rot.

This test currently asserts a whitespace-sensitive JSON substring ("\"role\":\"assistant\"") which could break if `gen_ai_json_dumps` formatting changes even when the encoded value is correct. Parsing the JSON and asserting the decoded field keeps the test focused on behavior.
